_readme: Ключ = slug. Эти проекты подмешиваются в каждую сборку и не могут быть вытеснены источниками. Обязательные поля: name, chain, event, status, description.

powerx-onewallet.name: PowerX OneWallet
powerx-onewallet.description: Self-custodial wallet and social app (live audio/video rooms, feed, messaging) with the PX1 utility token. The airdrop pays 500 PX1 for completing social tasks in the official Telegram bot; TGE not yet announced.

laptop-bitvavo.name: LAPTOP Airdrop (Bitvavo)
laptop-bitvavo.description: Manual, in-account claim at the Bitvavo exchange for a share of the LAPTOP token (Hunter Biden's memecoin on Base) allocated to TRUMP holders with a documented loss above 1,000 EUR. Deadline October 10, 2026.
